notice: This package records the exact owner decision for a bounded local non-production run. It authorizes no execution until the remaining source, method, adapter, boundary, capacity, and output gates pass, and never authorizes production use, release, external compute/storage, or broader claims.

maturity.reason: Decision and preflight evidence does not implement or validate a real-data transform.

forestDefinition.evidenceLimit: The publisher class labels identify treed cover types but do not establish, cell by cell, the registered one-hectare, ten-percent-crown-closure and five-metre-mature-height thresholds. Class 81 is treed wetland, but the repository evidence does not determine whether the product denominator should include it.

options.tradeoff: Uses only the three unambiguously named forest-cover classes and matches the tested synthetic crosswalk; it may undercount qualifying treed wetlands.
Includes the explicitly treed wetland class; the current evidence does not prove that every class-81 cell meets the registered forest thresholds.

forestDefinition.requiredMethodLabel: VLCE2 operational proxy for nfi-1; not a pixel-level measurement of all NFI thresholds

computePlan.recommendedExecution: single-worker, windowed and sequential; verify every source checksum first; retain at most the current and next decoded windows; write checksum-bound tiled/compressed non-production outputs; abort rather than exceed a cap
computePlan.capTradeoff: The 2 TiB disk cap is above the 970.7 GB uncompressed one-byte mask scale plus known compressed inputs, but patch vectorization can exceed estimates. Any cap breach must abort and return measured evidence for a new owner decision; it must not silently raise limits.
